title: Solving activation blocker
summary: Shipped work addressing an activation blocker for Boost Mobile.

sections.label: OVERVIEW
sections.title: Removing friction at the moment of activation.
sections.body: Focused on the steps that blocked new members from completing activation.

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.title: A critical step was unclear and caused drop-off.
sections.body: Members stalled when instructions and confirmation states were ambiguous.

sections.label: SOLUTION
sections.title: Clearer guidance and confirmation across the activation path.
sections.body: Redesigned key screens and messaging to reduce ambiguity.

sections.label: OUTCOME
sections.title: Shipped improvements to the activation journey.
sections.body: Reduced friction on the primary activation path.
